caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a doll, placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The doll has a human-like face with blue eyes, light brown hair, and flushed cheeks, and it wears a pink bonnet that is tied with a bow under the chin. The doll is dressed in a long-sleeved, brown dress featuring a diamond pattern, with white lace trim at the collar, cuffs, and around the lower hem. A large, loosely tied light blue bow is positioned around the waist of the dress. The doll's hands are simplified in form and lightly colored, and its legs are covered in pink stockings with red shoes. There is an inscription in cursive handwriting in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Paper Doll
